name: loomlet
goal: A polished, view-only multi-project fleet dashboard. (1) A prominent header diagram of the agent pipeline structure: PLANNER -> CODER -> TESTER -> deterministic GATE -> DEPLOY, with a feedback arrow showing failures return as issues, and the currently-active stage highlighted from live data. (2) One panel per registered project showing the project goal, progress (issues done / total), its coder+tester agent states, and its gate history (merges vs rejections with PR links). Auto-refreshes live, degrades gracefully when the fleet is offline, readable on mobile, coherent 'loom' aesthetic.
brief: Loomlet is the fleet's own live dashboard. Data source: GET /api/status on the same origin, returning JSON shaped `{"projects": {"<name>": {"goal": str, "done": int, "total": int, "complete": bool, "agents": {"coder": {"state","detail","since"}, "tester": {...}}, "events": [{"ts","kind",...}]}}, "agents": {<merged, keyed project:agent>}, "events": [<merged, newest-first, each with a project field>]}`. Event kinds: fleet_start, planner_start, issue_created, project_complete, issue_picked, agent_start, agent_done, pr_opened, verify_start, gate_green_merged (field: pr), gate_red (fields: pr, reasons[]), deployed, orchestrator_error. It is strictly READ-ONLY: there is no control surface and there are no secrets in the payload.

name: inkwell
goal: A clean, genuinely usable live Markdown previewer: textarea editor on the left, rendered HTML preview on the right updating as you type, supporting headings, bold, italic, inline code, fenced code blocks, links, ordered/unordered lists, blockquotes, and horizontal rules. Pleasant typography, a copy-HTML button, and persistence of the draft in localStorage. Polished and responsive.
brief: Inkwell is a live Markdown previewer: a single page with a textarea editor on the left and a rendered HTML preview on the right that updates as you type. Pure static HTML/CSS/JS in ui/, no frameworks and no external/CDN dependencies — implement the Markdown rendering yourself. It is a self-contained client-side tool with NO backend and NO /api/status — never fetch anything. Escape HTML in user input to prevent injection; render Markdown safely.
